==Description==
For tabulating [[Wookieepedia:Discussions|Discussions]] posts on [[Forum:Discussions index archive|Discussions index archive]] pages.

==Usage==
<pre>
{{DItable|
{{DItablerow|<!-- table row parameters -->}}
{{DItablerow|<!-- table row parameters -->}}
{{DItablerow|<!-- table row parameters -->}}
}}
</pre>

===Required parameters===
#Any number of {{Tl|DItablerow}} elements to fill the table. Include each one on a new line.

===Optional parameters===
*{{Para|sortable}} A flag to make the table sortable if set to <code>1</code>.
*{{Para|complete}} A flag to round the table's bottom corners if set to <code>1</code>.
*{{Para|noauthor}} A flag to omit the "Created by" column if set to <code>1</code>. If set, the table rows should also omit this column's fields.

==See also==
*{{Tl|DItablefilter}}
*{{Tl|DItablerow}}
